$comment: The franchise walk's regression corpus: big franchises with many films, specials and spin-offs (One Piece, Naruto, Bleach, Dragon Ball, Detective Conan, Gintama, Pokémon, Lupin III, Fate, Monogatari, JoJo, Attack on Titan), recorded from kitsu.io/api/edge.

cases.json.source: Hand-written: one case per anchor, what the walk must answer for it (the title of the run's first entry by start, which section holds the anchor, a side story's parent stories, ids a section must hold), pinned by backend/src/commands/franchise_corpus_test.rs.

listings.json.source: Recorded by backend/src/commands/franchise_corpus_record_test.rs: the franchise walk run from every anchor in cases.json, each listing it asked for read with the app's query (KitsuClient::franchise_relations) and each detail with KitsuClient::anime_detail, artwork dropped (the walk never reads it).

served-12.json.source: Written by backend/src/commands/franchise_corpus_record_test.rs (write_the_served_payloads): the walk's answer from One Piece (anime/12) over listings.json, as GET /api/kitsu/franchise/12 serves it, artwork absent; kept equal to the walk by franchise_corpus_test.rs. The frontend's strip and franchise page tests read it.
